item: the serving gate is a pure ASGI middleware that also refuses websockets, and never latches
summary: R644's gate was an @app.middleware("http"), which sees HTTP only, so a websocket route added later would have gone round it; and once open it latched. It is now a pure ASGI middleware: an HTTP request gets the fixed 503 and a websocket handshake is closed before it is accepted (code 1013) until the startup checked the loop and armed airplane mode's guard, and the loop check, the serving loop and the armed guard are read on every request, so a guard uninstalled later closes the gate again. Release line: the app's start-up safety gate now covers every kind of connection to it, not only page and API requests, and closes again if airplane mode's socket guard is ever taken away.
